subject: math
question: 已知 $\Gamma$ 为 $x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2} = 6y$ 与 $x^{2} + y^{2} = 4y (z \geqslant 0)$ 的交线，从 $z$ 轴正向看上去为逆时针方向，计算曲线积分 $\oint_{\Gamma}(x^{2} + y^{2} - z^{2}) \mathrm{d}x + (y^{2} + z^{2} - x^{2}) \mathrm{d}y + (z^{2} + x^{2} - y^{2}) \mathrm{d}z$ .

steps.text: 分析 空间曲线积分，需将曲线方程参数化，在此过程中要尽量先将曲线方程化简。由于这里是闭曲线的积分，因此也可以考虑用斯托克斯公式化为曲面积分计算。

方法1 $\Gamma$ 的方程可化为 $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} z = \sqrt{2y} \\ x^2 + y^2 = 4y \end{array} \right.$ ，记 $\Gamma$ 的 $x \geqslant 0$ 与 $x \leqslant 0$ 的两部分分别为 $\Gamma_1$ 与 $\Gamma_2$ ，其参

$$
\Gamma_ {1}: x = \sqrt {4 t - t ^ {2}}, y = t, z = \sqrt {2 t} (t: 0 \rightarrow 4); \Gamma_ {2}: x = - \sqrt {4 t - t ^ {2}}, y = t, z = \sqrt {2 t} (t: 4 \rightarrow 0)
$$

分别在 $\Gamma_{1}$ 和 $\Gamma_{2}$ 上积分，有

$$
\begin{array}{l} \oint_ {\Gamma_ {1}} (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} - z ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} x + (y ^ {2} + z ^ {2} - x ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} y + (z ^ {2} + x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} z \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {4} \left[ \left(\frac {2 t (2 - t)}{\sqrt {4 t - t ^ {2}}} + 2 (t ^ {2} - t) + \sqrt {2} \frac {3 t - t ^ {2}}{\sqrt {t}}\right) \right] \mathrm{d} t; \\ \oint_ {\Gamma_ {2}} (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} - z ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} x + (y ^ {2} + z ^ {2} - x ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} y + (z ^ {2} + x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} z \\ = \int_ {4} ^ {0} \left[ \left(\frac {- 2 t (2 - t)}{\sqrt {4 t - t ^ {2}}} + 2 (t ^ {2} - t) + \sqrt {2} \frac {3 t - t ^ {2}}{\sqrt {t}}\right) \right] \mathrm{d} t \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {4} \left[ \left(\frac {2 t (2 - t)}{\sqrt {4 t - t ^ {2}}} - 2 (t ^ {2} - t) - \sqrt {2} \frac {3 t - t ^ {2}}{\sqrt {t}}\right) \right] \mathrm{d} t. \end{array}
$$

两式相加，则

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \text {原式} & = 4 \int_ {0} ^ {4} \frac {t (2 - t)}{\sqrt {4 t - t ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} t \xlongequal {t - 2 = u} 4 \int_ {- 2} ^ {2} \frac {- (2 + u)}{\sqrt {4 - u ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} u \\ & = - 8 \int_ {0} ^ {2} \frac {u ^ {2}}{\sqrt {4 - u ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} u \xlongequal {u = 2 \sin t} - 8 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} 4 \sin^ {2} t \mathrm{d} t = - 8 \pi . \end{array}
$$

方法2 记 $P = x^{2} + y^{2} - z^{2}$ , $Q = y^{2} + z^{2} - x^{2}$ , $R = z^{2} + x^{2} - y^{2}$ , $\Sigma$ 为球面 $x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2} = 6y$ 位于交线 $\Gamma$ 上方的部分, 取上侧. 利用斯托克斯公式, 则

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \text {原式} & = \iint_ {\Sigma} \left(\frac {\partial R}{\partial y} - \frac {\partial Q}{\partial z}\right) \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z + \left(\frac {\partial P}{\partial z} - \frac {\partial R}{\partial x}\right) \mathrm{d} z \mathrm{d} x + \left(\frac {\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac {\partial P}{\partial y}\right) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \\ & = - 2 \iint_ {\Sigma} (y + z) \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z + (z + x) \mathrm{d} z \mathrm{d} x + (x + y) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y. \end{array}
$$

采用合一投影法计算. $\Sigma$ 在 $xOy$ 面的投影区域为 $D = \{(x,y) | x^2 + y^2 \leqslant 4y\}$ , $\Sigma: z = \sqrt{6y - x^2 - y^2}$ 的上侧法向量为 $n = (-z_x, -z_y, 1) = \left(\frac{x}{z}, \frac{y - 3}{z}, 1\right)$ , 故

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \text {原式} & = - 2 \iint_ {\Sigma} \left((y + z) \frac {x}{z} + (z + x) \frac {y - 3}{z} + (x + y)\right) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \\ & = - 2 \iint_ {\Sigma} \frac {1}{z} (2 x y + 2 y z + 2 z x - 3 z - 3 x) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \\ & = - 2 \iint_ {D} \frac {x (2 y - 3)}{\sqrt {6 y - x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y - 2 \iint_ {D} (2 y + 2 x - 3) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \\ & = 0 - 2 \iint_ {D} (2 y - 3) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \quad (\text {因} D \text {关于} x = 0 \text {对称}); \end{array}
$$

即

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \text {原式} & = - 4 \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \mathrm{d} \varphi \int_ {0} ^ {4 \sin \varphi} \rho^ {2} \sin \varphi \mathrm{d} \rho + 6 \pi \cdot 2 ^ {2} \\ & = - \frac {4}{3} \cdot 6 4 \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin^ {4} \varphi \mathrm{d} \varphi + 2 4 \pi = - 3 2 \pi + 2 4 \pi = - 8 \pi . \end{array}
$$

cdps.prompt: 如何将曲线参数化并代入 P dx+Q dy（或空间形式）？
cdps.expected: 写出参数方程与微分，化为定积分。

cdps.prompt: 最终第二型曲线积分结果是什么？

meta.commentary:
评注 （1）曲线 $\Gamma$ 的参数方程也可取为 $\Gamma:\left\{\begin{aligned}x=2\cos t\\ y=2(1+\sin t)(t:0\to2\pi).\\ z=2\sqrt{1+\sin t}\end{aligned}\right.$ 积分会更容易一些.

(2) 利用斯托克斯公式做计算时, 有向曲面 $\Sigma$ 的选取不是唯一的, 只要 $\Sigma$ 的边界曲线为 $\Gamma$ , 且 $\Sigma$ 侧与 $\Gamma$ 的正向符合右手法则即可. 选取 $\Sigma$ 的有效方法是便于曲面积分的计算.
